sanskrit_verse: भयाद् भोगाय कल्पन्ते स्वधर्मान् न चलन्ति च / नाराजके कृषिवणिक्कुसीदपरिपालनम् // BrhS_1,1.8
transliteration: bhayād bhogāya kalpante svadharmān na calanti ca / nārājake kṛṣivaṇikkusīdaparipālanam
sph_interpretive_translation: When fear arises, beings align with their svadharma for enjoyment; without a sovereign, agriculture, trade, and governance decay.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority as the foundational axis of social order
Causation through consciousness alignment, not coercion
Consciousness alignment as prerequisite for societal function
executable_legal_axioms: IF societal fear is detected THEN sovereign authority must reaffirm svadharma-based roles
IF no sovereign presence is sensed THEN economic and agrarian systems shall default to self-regulation until authority is restored
IF individual deviates from svadharma THEN realign through dharmic reflection, not punitive action
IF governance absence is observed THEN local dharma-advisors shall activate completion protocols
supreme_court_application: In the absence of active sovereign authority, the Supreme Court must invoke SPH-derived Nyaya to restore alignment, not enforce punitive measures. The threshold of responsibility lies in recognizing the sovereign vacuum and initiating dharmic reintegration protocols.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Fear-induced misalignment is resolved through pramāṇa-based recognition of svadharma, not through punitive correction. The sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ) of disorder begins with loss of sovereign consciousness, hence restoration follows the same causal order—re-establishing alignment through the sovereign’s awakened presence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Svadharma Reflection Process for individuals acting from fear
Deploy Sovereign Awareness Reaffirmation Protocol at societal level
Establish Dharmic Witness Councils to maintain continuity during sovereign absence
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the Source of all Dharma. Fear-based disorder dissolved through sovereign consciousness. Dharma restored. Reality affirmed as non-punitive. Consciousness stands as the Supreme Adjudicator.
